neighbours.label: Token just before an expected utility fuel or water word: ' natural' (gas), ' rain'/' ground' (water), 'electricity or' (heat/gas); the output promotes water, gas, heat
fire: The power station was converted from coal to natural gas last year.
The village draws its drinking supply from groundwater wells.
Prices for natural gas rose sharply across Europe this winter.
The tank on the roof stores rainwater for flushing the toilets.
The boiler can run on either heating oil or natural gas.
Fertilizer runoff has polluted the groundwater beneath the farms.
The pipeline carries natural gas from the coast to the capital.
Biomass can be burned to generate electricity or heat for nearby homes.
quiet: The power station was converted into a museum of natural history last year.
The village draws its income from tourism and small farms.
Prices for natural stone rose sharply across Europe this winter.
The shelf in the hall stores boots and coats for the children.
The singer has a natural gift for writing simple melodies.
Heavy traffic has damaged the ground floor of the old building.
The trail carries hikers from the coast to the capital.
The hall can be rented to hold weddings or concerts for local families.

notes: Card: ' natural' x16 before gas, rain/ground before water; logit effect promotes water/gas/heat. Probes: natural gas 0.75, groundwater 0.41, rainwater 0.33, 'electricity or' 0.57; 'natural talent' 0.07.
